main_measure.name: mean excess return close t+1 to close t+3 after top-decile positive forecasts, vs coin mean 2-bar return
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 non-overlapping cases is not observable

supporting_check.name: mean 3-bar excess return vs coin mean 3-bar return

decided_by: The mean excess return over days 2-3 is above 0 with t >= 2.
reading: Top decile = forecast >= 90th percentile of all pooled positive forecasts; coin mean 2-bar and 3-bar returns use every in-window bar of all windows; cases are merged within a window when within 3 bars of the previous case (chained), each merged case keeping its first bar's returns; cases lacking close t+3 in the window are dropped first.
